- Aug 4, 09:00–09:30 ET (before the transit block)
- Aug 5, 15:00–15:30 ET

Hi Priya — really appreciate the heads up. We can definitely adapt. Two quick asks so we recommend the right format:
1) Is the goal to give Nikhil a high-level executive walkthrough (product + cost/ops highlights) or a technical deep-dive?
2) If short, would 30 minutes need to include Q&A or is a 20-min demo + 10-min Q&A okay?

Options from our side (all times ET):
A) Aug 4, 09:00–09:30 — compress to a focused exec demo (we can do a 20/10 split).
B) Aug 5, 15:00–15:30 — same format but gives us more prep time for a tailored infra slide.
C) Keep Aug 4, 11:00 and we add a 10-min CTO-focused recap at 11:50 (we'd need a short follow-up link / recording).

If you want A or B, I can update the invite and share a one-page 30-minute agenda. If C, we'll keep everything as-is and I can mark the 11:50 recap as tentative.

Quick note: Kimberly can lead the exec portion and I can stay for Q&A. Vivek is available as technical backup. I attached a condensed agenda we use for 30-minute sponsor walk-throughs.

Attachments: agenda-30min.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks,
